missionPremise: src/domains.mjs states, in its own comment above DOMAIN_REGISTRY, that absence from the registry is the only surviving meaning of the words 'not built': the surface does not exist yet, while emptiness of a REGISTERED domain is a statement about SOURCES with a basis attached. Those are different sentences to a customer. Public works (cip-projects, call-analytics) and Fire and EMS (fire-apparatus) are registered and built; Parks has no vendor at all and therefore no registered domain, which the same file records as a finding rather than an omission. A design that rendered Parks as an empty Public works would collapse the two states this product deliberately keeps apart. v1 is being retired rather than run alongside, stated to the customer on the 2026-09-15 Jaime call, so shipping v2 without these three lenses removes capability from departments that have it today.
completionPredicate: Three folders exist under _design/ (smartcity-public-works-lens, smartcity-fire-ems-lens, smartcity-parks-lens), each carrying README.md, gen.mjs, a byte-identical _kit.css, its .dc.html artboards, canvas.json and check.mjs. `node gen.mjs && node check.mjs` exits 0 in each folder with a non-zero matched-input count for every predicate. Each check has been verified by violation against a real artboard and the artboard restored. Every artboard has been rendered by headless Chrome in both themes and looked at. Parks renders as a surface that does not exist, and its check refuses the built-surface vocabulary on Main while requiring it on the contrast board. A stranger can evaluate all of this by running the three checks and opening the eight boards.

Nothing was published: the folders are the artefact and its source, and publication is the planner's call. No product repo was written to; no live probe was run and no credential was used.

findings: THREE LENSES, THREE OBSTACLES, THREE KINDS. src/vendor-live.mjs is wired through REAL_LIVE_DOMAINS for all three regions and its own header records a verification dated 2026-09-03: Power BI returns data, GoTo returns goto_not_authorized because a human has never completed the OAuth consent, FirstDue returns a 403 because the credential lacks the apparatus and assets scope. Parks has no vendor. A consent, an entitlement and a missing source are three different asks and only one is ours.
THE LIVE CALL FEED IS ONE AGGREGATE RECORD. composeRealCallAnalytics maps a single all-queues-today summary; the demo pack's 5x5 queue grid does not survive the cutover, and the board says so.
TWO PATHS, OPPOSITE RULES, ON A RATIO. The call domain refuses to put an answer rate on a record; the live mapper carries answerRate straight from the vendor.
TWO PATHS, TWO NAMES, ONE CLASS. callsAbandoned on the generated record, callsMissed on the live one. Recommend callsAbandoned on both with a stated basis.
A REFUSAL THAT DOES NOT SURVIVE THE CUTOVER. The generated apparatus record carries crewBasis; the live mapper carries no crew field and no basis for its absence.
TWO LIVE MAPPERS FALL BACK TO A SENTINEL ID. unknown-apparatus and unknown-project collide across rows, and a has-an-id check passes on every one of them.

THE SHIPPED CIP TABLE DECLARES A COLUMN THE GENERATED RECORD CANNOT FILL. web/index.html gives it a Completion header; only the live mapper has the field. A blank cell in a percent column reads as zero.
THE LIVE CIP recordId IS THE PROJECT NAME, so Project and Subject collapse into one column when the feed lands.
A FORWARD-FACING WINDOW ON A HISTORICAL MEASURE. dayLabelFor produces today / in 1 day / in 4 days and the call domain applies it to volumes that have already happened.

THE PRODUCT'S MONEY GATE REFUSES THE WORDS 'PER CENT'. FORBIDDEN_CONTENT matches the standalone word cent, so British two-word spelling trips it on any surface. The product writes percent. Caught by this lane's own check on its own boards.

falsifier: If any of the three checks could pass on an artboard carrying an invented vendor kind, a person-shaped name, a money token on the Public works lens, record ids out of the composer's order, or, on Parks Main, any of the built-surface vocabulary, the instrument would be worthless and this close would be wrong. Each was planted on a real artboard and each was refused; the results are in CP2. The second falsifier, and the one that actually fired: if a predicate matched zero inputs the check would be reporting success while testing nothing. Two predicates did match zero on the first run against real boards and the files said so rather than passing.
contradicted: Three things this lane expected and found false. (1) The dispatch's framing that the three lenses differ mainly in their second axis: they also sit at three different distances from data, and the obstacle at each is a different KIND of thing, which turned out to be the stronger design spine and came from src/vendor-live.mjs rather than from the dispatch. (2) That a matrix reads better with the severity dimension as its rows: at 452px the long phase names collided as column headers and the matrix had to be transposed, which only the rendered board showed. (3) That the check's registry allowlist was populated: it was built from d.domainId while listDomains returns d.id, so it was empty and every pair would have passed vacuously. The self-test caught it and the file refused to report a verdict.
